Curated US local-news RSS feeds

Source: R/data.R
rss_local_rags.Rd

A pinned snapshot of the canonical Local Rags RSS output. Each row identifies one unique US local-news feed with publisher, feed, verification, Census division, county, and rural-urban geography. Access it directly as textpress::rss_local_rags. Full discovery and 3DLNews provenance remain in the source project.

rss_local_rags

Format

A data frame with one row per feed and 11 variables: source, feed, url, verified_at, latest_item_at, census_division, state_abbr, county, five-character fips county code, rucc_2023, and metro_status.

Source

Local Rags RSS, https://github.com/jaytimm/local-rags-rss, derived from 3DLNews, https://github.com/wm-newslab/3DLNews.

Examples

head(textpress::rss_local_rags)
#>                source                       feed
#> 1  Alaska Native News         Alaska Native News
#> 2 Chilkat Valley News        Chilkat Valley News
#> 3       Cordova Times          The Cordova Times
#> 4     Delta Discovery  The Delta Discovery, Inc.
#> 5        Frontiersman Mat-Su Valley Frontiersman
#> 6          Homer News                 Homer News
#>                                        url                 verified_at
#> 1     https://alaska-native-news.com/feed/ 2026-08-26T04:20:10.706474Z
#> 2  https://www.chilkatvalleynews.com/feed/ 2026-08-26T14:53:08.998106Z
